ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with white pixels concentrated at the lateral tips and scattered small circular nodes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous low-intensity (black) region covering >90% of the fluke area. Distinct high-intensity (white) geometric blobs are localized at the distal lateral tips. Scattered discrete circular white clusters are distributed across the dark ventral field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central notch with an estimated angle of 110 degrees and a depth-to-height ratio of approximately 0.1.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2 and 12 pixels; serration frequency increases significantly toward the lateral lobe extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved trajectory for each lobe, exhibiting initial convexity near the median notch and transitioning to a convex sweep at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (~5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark ventral field, with heavy aggregation and coalescence at the lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of white, textured barnacle colonization localized at the extreme lateral margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
